This is the worst service ever, why
1.	They install completely duplicate spare parts and charge the customer as much as the original spare part. 6.	Even they do not provide me GST bill
7.	After service most of the time they will not pick-up our call

Overall, they are installing duplicate parts, giving fake warranty, giving duplicate bills, fake assurance to customers, lying and cheating the customer.

featured_reviews.name: amityummit
featured_reviews.review_text:
So i have "Pureit Classic Auto fill 23 Ltr"

Service 1 (6 Months ago) - The bottom collection Chamber feet got cracked and it was leaking, called Pureit CC, and (unfortunately for me) they routed the Service to Taj..and their personal arrived NOT ON TIME, and since I was not there, the service person named "B" broked the Connecting Rod which holds the (Cylindrical Shaped) Water Polisher in the bottom collection Chamber and replaced the bottom collection Chamber..

Service 2 (Current) - After my 3000 Ltr filter got used up, got another one and when i opened the Water filter to replace, found the broken Connecting Rod broken, and Water Polisher was sunk to the bottom of the bottom collection Chamber (We were drinking straight up Chlorinated Water for 6 months without knowledge), called Pureit CC again..rinse & repeat..
Same service person named "B" arrived NOT ON TIME, (he tried to delay schedule as much as possible) I was waiting for him, gave him "Peace of my mind" about previous Service, he replaced the Connecting Rod assembly, which he jammed into the bottom collection Chamber (Got to Know later), after the service was done, I left for work, got a call from my parents about Leakage from Water filter, when I arrived, it was leaking from the thread where it was jammed, after removing the jammed Connecting Rod (The O ring was overlapping the thread, so it was not making Water tight seal and the reason of been jammed), re seated the O ring properly in the groove, and Water filter is working fine without any Problem..

After getting 2 services from Taj, my observation is, either their Service Personal are "illiterate hacks" or trying to Con their gullible clients..

"Taj" Service is not up to their name..

Attached picture is of Connecting Rod assembly with O ring pulled out from left side, that's how I found it when opened my replacement jammed Connecting Rod..
